OAMS.notes: Mazar-i-Sharif (OAMS / MZR), Afghanistan, USD. Sources: Afghanistan Civil Aviation Authority fees regulation (international: ATC 150 arrival + 150 departure, landing 10 per ton (MTOW), parking first 4 h free then every 24 h 4 per ton, lighting sunrise–sunset 60 / sunset–sunrise 60, aviation security 500 per flight, cargo security 100; domestic: no ATC, landing 3 per ton, parking 1.5 per ton, lighting 20, security 200; departing pax tax table blank; children up to 2 years exempt) and SONIC JET quote (12 Nov 2026; CL-60 24.5 t, pax; "E35L" noted): landing 245 approx (min 100), parking 98 per day (first 4 h free), ATC 400, lighting 150 approx, departing pax tax 40; basic handling transit 1,700 / turnaround 2,100, technical stop 1,050 (incl. marshalling, pax steps up to 2 h, water/toilet on request, cargo breakdown, baggage equipment); GPU 700 per hour, ACU 1,200 per hour, push back conventional 500 / wide body 700 per use, labor 100, supervision & arrangement 400, supervision at night 500 (18:00–03:00 UTC), disbursement 10%, sales government tax 4%, admin/communication 35, landing permission / PPR 130; cargo handling of combined flights 60 per ton, reload 90 per ton, warehouse 0.5 / 0.25 / 0.10 per kg; cancellation 30% of handling < 12 h, 50% < 6 h before STA. USER DECISIONS (13 Nov 2026): handler SONIC JET; handling only in E35L group (quote group); airport fees by CAA per ton in all groups (22 / 24.5 / 34 / 42 / 46 / 53 t); ATC 400 and lighting 150 as on Sonic quote (CAA 300 / 60 per movement; to be compared when another handler quotes); aviation security 500 from CAA in basket (not on quote); turnaround 2,100 in basket, transit and technical stop as tick rows replacing it; supervision 400 + night difference 100 automatic (22:30–07:30 local); admin 35, PPR 130, ACU and push back in basket, GPU per hour, labor tick; disbursement 10% on airport fees; sales tax 4% not entered (tax); cargo, warehouse and cancellation not entered. BALKH AIR SERVICES ground handling charges sheet (undated, entered as 12 Nov 2026; USD; prices shown NB/WB = narrow body / wide body, valid for scheduled and non-scheduled flights): basic handling pax flight by MTOW 0–9.99 t 2,496, 10–24.99 t 3,168, 25–39.99 t 3,936, 40–79.99 t 4,320 (cargo 2,592 / 3,360 / 4,416 / 4,992; larger classes not relevant); NB: GPU 410 per hour, fresh water 200, wheelchair 25, additional toilet 200 (1 included), push back 350 per movement, towing 450 per leg, additional stairs 170 per hour, ACU 550 per hour, de-ice equipment 1,500, CUTE 110, DCS 110, meteo/flight ops file printing 80, ATS flight plan print 50, de-ice fluid 14 per litre, ASU 420 per bleed, LDL 400 / MDL 600 per hour, jack 80, forklift 100, cherry picker 170, catering transfer 300, crew bus 100 (1 included), cabin cleaning 250, cabin disinfection 70, hold disinfection 120, cabin dressing 150, hold cleaning 110, garbage 70, ambulift 150, headset 30 (1 included), conveyor 150 (1 included), pax bus 150 (1 included), offloading baggage 100 per pax, nitrogen 200. USER DECISIONS (13 Nov 2026): NB prices; all groups by MTOW; airport fees from CAA (ATC 300, lighting 60 per movement = 120, landing 10 per ton, parking ton × 4 per 24 h after 4 h, security 500) and departing pax tax 40 (Sonic; CAA table blank); no disbursement (not stated); handling, GPU per hour, ACU and push back in basket; other services tick; cargo and WB-only items not entered. BALKH AIR SERVICES invoice (14 Nov 2026; A6-AFO E35L, MTOW 24 t / 24,300 kg on ramp log 12682, DXB–OAMS–DXB, ATA 20:43, ATD 21:52, 14 Nov 2026): basic ground handling (10–24.99 t) 3,168, supervision 200 per flight; subtotal 3,368, taxes 4% 134.72, total 3,502.72. Ramp log: tractor 20:44–21:52 (not charged), supervision. No airport fees on invoice. USER DECISIONS (16 Nov 2026): Balkh supervision 200 in all groups; 4% tax not entered; CAA airport fees kept; green and ticked (handling invoice exact). SONIC JET trip cost estimate (24 Nov 2026; GL-5 42 t, pax, civil side): airport fees unchanged (landing 420 approx, parking 168 per day first 4 h free, ATC 400, lighting 150 approx, departing pax tax 40); basic handling transit 2,300 / turnaround 2,900, technical stop 1,450; GPU 700 per hour, ACU 1,200 per hour, push back conventional 500 / wide body 700, labor 100, supervision & arrangement 500, supervision at night 600 (18:00–03:00 UTC), disbursement 10%, sales government tax 4%, admin/communication 35, landing permission / PPR 130. USER DECISIONS (25 Nov 2026): GL5T column entered from this estimate (same structure as E35L; night difference 100); GLEX and GL7T handling left empty (to be requested from Sonic Jet); wide body push back not entered; sales tax not entered; green/tick and verified unchanged.
